text: Assumption: The separation between KeySlot and WriteableKeySlot separates read accesses from writing key modifications — is this correct?

norm: the separation between keyslot and writeablekeyslot separates read accesses from writing key modifications
assumption: The separation between KeySlot and WriteableKeySlot separates read accesses from writing key modifications.
rationale: According to the payload, WriteableKeySlot is specified as a writable storage location, KeySlot generally as a storage location.
